segments.contextAfter: You can now indicate whether an ad is a view-through ad or a StoreKit-rendered ad by using the new `fidelity-type` parameter. The `fidelity-type` value is `0` for view-through ads, and `1` for StoreKit-rendered ads. You include this parameter when you sign an ad, and receive it in the postback.
